exercises.title: TBD 1 — proceeding with TBDs
exercises.problemHtml:
Resolve all TBDs before implementing a set of requirements: leftover uncertainty makes developers and testers guess (and they often guess rather than track down the originator). If you must proceed with TBDs, either defer those requirements or design that part to be easily modifiable when the TBD is resolved — and log each TBD as an issue with an owner.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Giải quyết TBD trước khi hiện thực; nếu buộc phải làm tiếp thì hoãn phần đó hoặc thiết kế phần đó dễ sửa khi TBD được giải.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: TBD 2 — screens in the SRS: benefit or risk?
exercises.problemHtml:
Putting UI designs in the SRS has trade-offs. Benefits: mock-ups and wireframes make requirements tangible. Risks: screens describe solutions, may not be true requirements, bloat the document, and change often; screen layouts do not replace written requirements — developers should not have to deduce functionality and data from screenshots.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.problemHtml:

exercises.title: TBD 4 — more or less formal specification on an agile project?
exercises.problemHtml:
How much written specification an agile team needs depends on: whether just-in-time conversation can supply the details; whether informal communication keeps the team synchronised across time and space; whether requirements knowledge must be retained for maintenance, verification, audit, certification or contracts; and whether acceptance tests can serve as the detailed requirements. For each situation, does it push toward more or less written detail?

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
